goal: Prevent peers from bypassing node orphan memory limits with witness-heavy transactions
Protect nodes against excessive memory use and CPU spikes when handling unconfirmed transactions

agreement: Substantive support with testing confirming orphan memory limits are enforced (jeanpablojp, nervana21)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because peers can bypass orphan memory bounds to consume excessive node memory and spike CPU
A standard weight transaction can consume 28 times its accounted memory limit
Peers can exploit this mismatch to cause denial of service with relatively low bandwidth cost
